anomalies.description: A man in a dark suit is seen from behind aiming a handgun toward the right side of the frame; muzzle flash is visible in frame f4 (6.0s), indicating discharge.; A person in dark clothing is seen aiming and firing a handgun toward the right side of the frame; muzzle flash is visible at the barrel, and a motorcycle rider is seen falling immediately afterward.

After the first shot, a person is seen lying motionless on the ground beside the road in frames f6–f8, while the motorcyclist remains nearby; this indicates an attack on a helpless victim.; A person is lying motionless on the ground while another individual, seen from behind, approaches and appears to aim a firearm at them.

A silver station wagon approaches head-on while a motorcycle rider is on the ground; the car appears to strike or run over the fallen rider, as the rider is no longer visible in the subsequent frame and the car continues forward without stopping.

The same man is again seen from behind, holding and aiming a handgun; a second muzzle flash appears in frame f10 (9.0s), consistent with another shot being fired.; A muzzle flash is visible near the person's hands in frame f2 (9.0s), consistent with a firearm being discharged toward the prone individual.
